facts.fact: Times of Eswatini reports that the Eswatini Communications Commission, acting as the Eswatini Data Protection Authority established under the Data Protection Act 2022, began validation workshops on draft health-data guidelines on 28 July 2026, with an acting chief executive named as head.
facts.system: ESCCOM acting as the Eswatini Data Protection Authority (EDPA)

systems.system: Eswatini Data Protection Authority (EDPA), exercised by ESCCOM

note: The article reports one concluded complaint against an unnamed healthcare practitioner with no details, so no ruling against a named organisation is stated.
